name: Long May the Night
source:
A short AVG about a broken world of never-ending night sealed in a photo. Acting as the vampire duke, reclaim your vampire power to repair this long night. 

Made for <Narrative Driven Jam #10>, "Long nights"\"Caught on camera" themes.

Also (maybe) fits in <Mini Jam 118>, "Vampires"\"Blood is lethal" themes,

[From [url=https://xlores-liang.itch.io/long-may-the-night]Itch.io[/url]]
